title: 2033 年前全球投运制氢电解容量会达到 100 GW 吗？
Will operating hydrogen electrolysis reach 100 GW globally before 2033?
rules: 截至 2032 年底，全球已安装／调试且可制氢的水电解额定电输入容量 ≥100 GW；优先 IEA，若口径中断则用两家独立可靠跟踪机构。
By end-2032 global installed/commissioned water-electrolysis electrical input capacity must reach ≥100 GW; use IEA first or two independent trackers if unavailable.
interpretation: 排除仅宣布、在建及制造商 GW/年制造能力；标题年份不表示包含 2033 全年。
Exclude announcements, construction and manufacturing GW/year; the title does not include all of 2033.

summary: 原题针对已投运电解设备的电输入能力。制造产能与项目管线规模另行统计，不能计入 100 GW。
The question concerns commissioned electrical input capability; manufacturing and project-pipeline totals do not count toward 100 GW.
checklist: 核对装机可运行状态及水电解用途。
按额定电输入 GW 汇总，排除 GW/年。
核对 2032 年底前的统计参考期。

stage: 材料与试验 → 产品验证 → 实际应用
Materials and tests → product verification → application
impact: IEA 记录已安装、在建和已宣布项目，能够帮助检查范围。某家公司宣布设备产能或拿到项目订单，并不意味着电解系统已投运并满足原题装机条件。
IEA distinguishes installed, construction and announced projects. A manufacturer’s capacity or order book does not establish commissioned electrolysis meeting the contract.
gap: 仅统计符合投运定义的容量，不用项目管线填数。
Count only operational capacity, without substituting project pipelines.

title: 电解装机、氢产量与成本
Electrolysis capacity, hydrogen output and cost
principle: 电解水的产氢与产氧反应由电力驱动。效率、利用小时、电价、设备寿命和系统边界共同决定平准化成本，GW 装机不能单独给出年产量。
Electricity drives hydrogen and oxygen evolution. Efficiency, utilization, price, life and system boundaries determine levelized cost; GW capacity alone does not give annual output.
example: IEA 的 2025 年超过 4 GW 是已安装电解容量；接近 1 Mt 低排放氢包含其他路径。DOE 2031 年目标也不同于原题 2030 年价格条件。
IEA’s over 4 GW is 2025 installed electrolysis; almost 1 Mt low-emissions hydrogen includes other routes. DOE’s 2031 target differs from the market’s 2030 condition.

label: 参与较少
Few participants
detail: 概率来自少量参与者；查看成交数量与原始规则。
Few participants contribute; review activity and source rules.
